title: Unslop — Edit the AI out of your draft
excerpt: A writing tool that preserves your voice through AI editing. Fixes cadence, structure, and lexical density. Not just synonyms.
content_html:
Unslop

You used AI to fix the grammar. Now it reads like AI wrote it. Unslop rewrites the cadence, structure, and word choice back toward you, without touching what you meant.
